comment: Curated weapon-effect overrides (docs/architecture/weapon-effects.md 3.2), merged by tools/effects/weapon_effects_table.py into <game>/x3m/weapon_effects.json. by_id applies to any TBullets table carrying the SS_BULLET_* id; by_table[<decoded TBullets sha256 prefix>] applies to that exact table only and wins. Fields: style (tracer|slug|orb|wave|beam), tint ([r, g, b] linear 0..1), calibre (0..1), hull (repair|tug: the hull-hit variant, docs/architecture/weapon-look.md 3.1; energy|ballistic|plasma|heavy|ion: the hull-impact class pin where the flags carry nothing the name does, docs/architecture/hull-impact-classes.md section 2, the list of verification/results/weapon-effects/hull_class_census.py); the bolt hand pins (docs/architecture/bolt-muzzle-look.md 11.5, 2026-11-08: the census cue is mechanical and three weapons read as the wrong projectile): bolt_e_body (the body radiance E_b, default 1.2), bolt_w_orb (the orb diameter in w, default 1.6), bolt_halo (false: no halo), bolt_tint (texture: the body texture mean even over a saturated light colour). MASS/MD: a kinetic slug, not the brightest laser (style slug, E_b 0.6, no halo; MD also the texture tint, which its impacts share: the stock MASS body has no decodable texture, so its grey light stays); HEPT: plasma as a slug with its 30 ms tail, not a laser; FBL: a fragment ball, an orb at 2.0 w. Users edit nothing; an unknown mod gets the classifier.
